description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Crystal Force Mode], [Crystal Force Mode: Vivi (Fire)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: One single attack (34.60 each), grants [Damage Cap +10000 1], [Fire Ability Instant Cast 1], [Fire Ability +30% Boost 1], [Dualcast Fire 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1] and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: One single attack (34.60 each), grants [Damage Cap +10000 1], [Fire Ability Instant Cast 1], [Fire Ability +30% Boost 1], [Dualcast Fire 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1] and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Vivi (Fire)
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)
description.text: Ignores 25% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions
